background_workflow: flat #00ff00 chroma-key generated by gpt-image-2, then local chroma removal to PNG alpha
base_body_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: project-bound transparent avatar base body for a SwiftUI/Live2D-style layered character rig. Create a front-facing full-body human-like base avatar body for a magic wardrobe sticker app. The character should look like a gentle young adult woman, clearly human, not a toy doll, mannequin, puppet, chibi, or mascot. She must have no fixed hairstyle: use a smooth bald head / very light neutral head cap only, with visible ears and face so separate transparent hair layers can be placed on top later. Outfit must be a modest pale ivory base undergarment/unitard suitable for a rigging base, not nude and not lingerie. Natural soft anime illustration, delicate face, clean body proportions, neutral A-pose with arms slightly away from body, legs straight, hands and feet visible. Keep limbs, waist, torso, neck, and shoulders clear for skeletal layer splitting. Background: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key only, no shadows, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane. Constraints: no fixed hair, no props, no watermark, no text, no cropped limbs, no green in the subject.

short_bob_hairstyle_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: project-bound gpt-image-2 source asset for an alternate Live2D-riggable hairstyle package. Create a full-body front-facing anime wardrobe assistant base avatar matching the proportions and pose of a Live2D dress-up doll base: young adult stylized character, elegant and refined, soft smile, large expressive eyes, same matte warm white and very pale blue unitard / bodysuit with visible joint guide rings at shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles. notes: No Pencil output is used for the committed avatar asset.
The app-facing static mannequin is a no-fixed-hairstyle human base body, scaled down in SwiftUI so clothing stickers do not cover the whole avatar.
Hair is stored as replaceable transparent hair-only packages with matching layer contracts.
The ornate dress is stored as an embedded default outfit layer package and is hidden from the normal sticker list.
Layer PNGs are first-pass engineering crops from gpt-image-2 full-body sources.
Final Cubism production should redraw hidden overdraw for joints before binding.
